newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.4508 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.4508 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate rose to 2.4508 percent a month from 2.442 percent last week at Tuesday's 5.817 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction result was in line with market expectations, they said.
The 56-day bonds will mature on February 5. Today's auction is expected to add 683 million reais to the banking system, with 6.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
